data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.6m (2014:GBP 3.8m) due primarily to a reduction in claims estimates as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwinds. 2014 included a reduction in respect of reserves required for Superstorm Sandy. The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a release of GBP 0.3m (2014: GBP 1.7m). The large release last year was as a consequence of favourable development in Superstorm Sandy claims. RITC 2012 YOA commuted into Syn 2791 (4,250).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable development reduced reserves (noted as contributing to releases in 2014/2015).

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation of 2012 year of account into Syndicate 2791
prior_year_events.impact_description: Commutation removed the 2012 year liabilities from the syndicate, reducing gross claims outstanding by GBP 4.25m.

named_events.loss_description: Referenced as having led to favourable development and a reduction in reserves required.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 5.119m. During 2015 gross claims outstanding fell to GBP 0.953m largely as a result of the commutation of the 2012 year of account into Syndicate 2791 (a GBP 4.25m gross reduction) and some favourable development on prior years. Using the gross claims development triangle (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) there is a small gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 0.036m (c.-0.7% of opening gross claims). The report attributes releases to favourable claims development as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwinds, notably referencing Superstorm Sandy, and notes the material impact of the 2012 YOA commutation.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The triangle is affected by a large RITC commutation (2012 YOA) which materially reduces gross outstanding claims; this commutation is a structural transaction rather than reserve re-estimation. Some narrative figures in the report are quoted net of reinsurance; where possible gross figures were used. The PYD figure (-GBP 0.036m) is small and derived from the 2013 column only after excluding the two most recent underwriting years per the instructions.
